newsitem.title: INDIA: Eight shot dead in India tribal warfare.
newsitem.headline: Eight shot dead in India tribal warfare.

text.p: More than 50 armed men of the Kuki tribe attacked members of the rival Naga tribe in northeastern India, killing eight Nagas, police said on Thursday.

The attack on Wednesday, in which Paite tribespeople, a sub-group of the Nagas, were attacked, took place at Thanlon village in the Churachandpur district of the mountainous state of Manipur near the Burmese border, police said.
The Kukis set 50 houses ablaze in the village.
Kukis are fighting for a homeland in the highlands of Manipur and target ethnic Nagas, who are in a majority in the neighbouring state of Nagaland.
More than 60 people have been killed in clashes between the Kuki and Paite tribes since June, police said in Guwahati, the main city of the neighbouring state of Assam.
